events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the day influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Impact and Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, the impact of Tupac Shakur's music and message still resonates. His legacy continues to shape hip-hop culture and beyond.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who tragically passed away on this day.

angles.name: Enduring Influence
angles.copy: The sound of Jimi Hendrix redefined rock guitar forever. His innovative spirit continues to inspire musicians across generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Album Milestone
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles crossed that zebra crossing. 'Abbey Road' remains a masterpiece, closing an incredible chapter in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to Chrissie Hynde! A true rock 'n' roll icon whose distinctive voice and attitude have powered The Pretenders for decades.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock and Roll Star
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher is 54 today! Still bringing that unmistakable swagger and voice to the world of rock and roll.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Song of Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that continues to inspire hope and peace around the globe.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the groundbreaking first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago today, the original iPod arrived and changed how we listened to music forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: International James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the first Bond film premiere, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years of 007, from the iconic gadgets to the unforgettable theme tunes. What's your favourite Bond moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Musical Genius
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we honour the unparalleled musical genius and enduring spirit of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Python to Fawlty Towers.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate and adoration.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day.

angles.name: Unforgettable Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Pivotal Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived, marking a significant shift in their sound and songwriting. A truly pivotal record.

events.title: John Lennon's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the tragic anniversary of the passing of music legend John Lennon.

angles.name: Lasting Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.
